description: Na₃B₆O₁₀Br crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Br atoms to form distorted NaBr₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaBr₂O₄ octahedra and edges with two equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are two shorter (2.43 Å) and two longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.02 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.91 Å. There is one shorter (3.22 Å) and one longer (3.43 Å) Na-Br bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O and two equivalent Br atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.55 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-Br bond lengths are 3.36 Å. There are four inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.36 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond length. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaBr₂O₄ octahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.52 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.53 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and two B atoms to form distorted ONa₂B₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BrNa₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₂B₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one BrNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 87-93°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. Br is bonded to six Na atoms to form distorted BrNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BrNa₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₂B₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂B₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-27°.
